evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/runelite/a/g is a static legacy menu-action opcode holder. Its constants include the classic 317 walk/NPC/player/object/inventory action IDs, including 516; NPC 20/412/225/965/478/1025/582/413; player 561/779/27/577/729/491/365; object 502/900/113/872/1062/1226; and inventory-item 74/454/539/493/847/447/1125.
Its four boolean classifiers partition live menu IDs into NPC, player, object and inventory-item interaction families: a(int), b(int), c(int) and d(int) respectively.

Recovered NpcIndicators, InteractHighlight, MenuEntrySwapper and HoverDescriptions consumers feed live menu IDs into these classifiers. NPC-family consumers then use the menu index mapping to recover the exact NPC and definition, while object/item/player paths branch through their corresponding groups.

The same class resolves a live menu row through Client menu-index arrays to the associated NPC entry/definition and exposes its definition ID, keeping the utility centered on legacy menu-action opcode interpretation rather than arbitrary numeric constants.

proposals.note: LegacyMenuActionOpcode is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the legacy 317-style menu opcode constant/classifier utility. The numeric families and live menu consumers fix the role; no claim is made that this was the original developer source identifier. Confidence is 0.999.
